newsitem.title: CHINA: Australian insurer to China glass wool venture.
newsitem.headline: Australian insurer to China glass wool venture.

text.p: Australia's Colonial Mutual Group has pledged to invest 120 million yuan ($14.5 million) in a glass wool joint venture in the hometown of China's paramount leader, Deng Xiaoping, company officials said on Monday.

Colonial Mutual Group and China's Huabo Group would establish the Guang'an Glass Wool Factory in Guang'an county in the southwestern Sichuan province, an Colonial Mutual official told Reuters by telephone. He declined to say how much Huabo would invest.
The joint venture was expected to have an annual output value of nearly 100 million yuan ($12 million), officials said without elaborating.
